title: VC-203-010 production gaps: resource URI admission, access guard, sealed and bounded reads, cancellation
goal: An audit of VC-203-010's mastery target against crates/susi-gmcp/src/protocol.rs found the resource surface had discovery, templates, completion, pagination, cache hints and subscriptions, but no central URI validation or traversal refusal, no access-control point, no check that binary content is strict base64 or that MIME types are well formed, no size bound, an empty contents array could be served, and a cancelled read left its provider running. Add those on the production path and prove each on the wire against GmcpService, including pagination over a large catalog, a stale cursor, a resource replaced during reads, and subscription delivery.

reuse.searched: susi-gmcp content.rs already had is_valid_uri, is_valid_mime_type and is_valid_base64 (VC-203-008) and protocol.rs already had cursor paging and change broadcast; the new admission and seal steps call those instead of adding validators. The wire harness in the protocol suite is shared with the new suite. No new dependency.

limitations: The access guard is a hook: core ships no policy of its own, an embedder sets one.
A read is one bounded response of at most 8 MiB; larger resources are refused, not streamed.
